name: io.github.jweezy119/Pabandi
title: PabandiOS
description: Trust and settlement for AI agents: portable attestations, escrow, x402/USDC payments on Solana.

tools.name: pabandi_list_businesses
tools.description: List active businesses for booking, with optional city, category, search, and cursor pagination.

tools.name: pabandi_get_business
tools.description: Get one business by ID.

tools.name: pabandi_create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking and its escrow record. Requires authentication.

tools.name: pabandi_get_booking
tools.description: Get a booking with its escrow state.

tools.name: pabandi_mark_checkin
tools.description: Mark a booking as attended. A verified check-in moves escrow to conditions_met; an overridden check-in opens a dispute.

tools.name: pabandi_release_escrow
tools.description: Release a booking escrow to the business after verified completion. Requires business owner or admin.

tools.name: pabandi_refund_booking
tools.description: Refund a booking deposit under policy. Requires client, business owner, or admin.

tools.name: pabandi_verify_passport
tools.description: Verify a Pabandi trust disclosure or passport signature.

tools.name: pabandi_screen_wallet
tools.description: Screen a Solana wallet address for on-chain threat score, drainer activity, and sanctions risk via Webacy Risk Intelligence before funding escrow.

tools.name: pabandi_request_payout
tools.description: Request a USDC payout to a local rail, bank, or connected account. Requires authentication.

tools.name: pabandi_get_payout_history
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's payout history.

tools.name: pabandi_get_paid_proof
tools.description: Get a public payment proof by its public ID.

tools.name: pabandi_get_my_paid_proofs
tools.description: Get the authenticated worker's payment proofs.

tools.name: pabandi_get_identity
tools.description: Return the authenticated agent or user identity.

tools.name: pabandi_search_auto_repair
tools.description: Search US auto repair shops by zip code / location and service type (e.g. "brakes"). Returns shops, ML Trust Scores (Fair Price & Communication), and next available bay.

tools.name: pabandi_book_auto_repair
tools.description: Book an auto repair order on behalf of a car owner. Decodes the vehicle VIN via NHTSA, creates a RepairOrder (isBookedByAgent: true), runs the AI Fair-Price Guardrail, and triggers an SMS Magic Link for the owner to approve & fund the deposit. Requires an agent API key with booking scope.

tools.name: pabandi_check_shop_trust
tools.description: Check an auto repair shop's ML-calculated Pabandi Trust Score including Fair Price Score, Communication Score, and verified inspection proof metrics.

tools.name: pabandi_ai_status
tools.description: Report which AI providers and the Jev decision engine are configured. Booleans only, never credentials — useful for agents deciding whether to request AI-backed work.

tools.name: pabandi_ai_classify
tools.description: Classify a customer message into intent, language and confidence using the internal NLP model chain (with deterministic fallback).

tools.name: pabandi_ai_concierge
tools.description: Natural-language business discovery: returns a ranked proposal with trust/escrow framing and alternatives. Read-only — it never books or moves funds.

tools.name: pabandi_get_booking_risk
tools.description: Read the latest learned risk assessment (score, band, policy, factors) for a booking.
